items.description: a loaf or piece of bread

items.name: Fruit

items.name: Boat-Building Handbook
items.description: a handbook on building a small boat

items.name: Mist Lantern

chapter.label: CHAPTER 01 · PROLOGUE
chapter.title: Before the Journey
chapter.intro: You found a map leading to the misty pass. Gather supplies, knowledge, and a little courage in town before you leave.
chapter.complete_text: You finished the prologue! Exploration and combat quests for the next chapter are in development.

quests.title: Supplies for the Road
quests.detail: Get food or a drink for your journey from Maya. This quest is complete when the item enters your inventory.

quests.title: Boat-Building Handbook
quests.detail: Get a boat-building handbook from Lina. This quest is complete when the book enters your inventory.

quests.title: One Last Stop
quests.detail: Talk to Leo in English and take a break before your journey.

chapter.label: CHAPTER 02 · AN OLD FRIEND
chapter.title: An Old Friend
chapter.intro: Someone in town still remembers you. Make a plan, keep your word, and get the boat ready for the misty pass.
chapter.complete_text: The boat floats this time! The Misty Pass is coming soon.

quests.title: Morning Bread
quests.detail: Visit the bakery in the morning (06:00–12:00). Sleep in your bed at home if it is late.

phone.text: Hey, it's Sam! This is my number. Text me back? 😄

quests.title: Text Sam Back
quests.detail: Open your phone (M) and answer Sam's message in English.

phone.text: I got my camera bag! Do you want to meet today? Where and when?

quests.title: Meet Sam
quests.detail: Agree on a place and a time with Sam, then be there. Sam waits for one game hour.

quests.title: Ready to Sail
quests.detail: Bring the boat-building handbook to the pier. Sam is fixing a little boat there.

chapter.label: CHAPTER 03 · THE MISTY ISLES
chapter.title: The Misty Isles
chapter.intro: Beyond the mist lie islands of crystal and stone. The old lighthouse has been dark for years. Find out why, and bring the light back.
chapter.complete_text: The lighthouse shines again and the mist is lifting. More isles are waiting beyond it.

quests.title: Land Ho!
quests.detail: Sail to the Misty Isles from the pier in town, then look around with Sam.

quests.title: The Mist Market
quests.detail: Visit the Mist Market and ask Tobias about the dark lighthouse.

quests.title: The Rune Gate
quests.detail: Walk to the rune gate on the bridge and cast a spell: say a full English sentence with the magic word.

quests.title: The Keeper of the Light
quests.detail: Meet Elowen at the lighthouse and ask how to bring the light back.

quests.title: A Fair Trade
quests.detail: Get the Mist Lantern from Tobias. He never gives anything away: offer a fair trade or convince him politely.

quests.title: Light the Lighthouse
quests.detail: Bring the Mist Lantern to the lighthouse.

tiers.story_note: Story so far (Chapter 4): the lighthouse shines again, but Morwen, the witch of the Thornwood, has cursed the isles: the Thornwood has turned dark and the curse is spreading. Orrin the alchemist lives in the Alchemy Lab on the eastern isle; the player is now his lab assistant. Together they must brew a moonlight potion to break the curse.

chapter.label: CHAPTER 04 · THE THORNWOOD WITCH
chapter.title: The Thornwood Witch
chapter.intro: A witch's curse is spreading from the dark Thornwood. Become the lab assistant of Orrin the alchemist, brew a potion together and face Morwen in her tower.
chapter.complete_text: The curse is broken and the Thornwood is green again. Even the witch has found a friend.

quests.title: A Shadow over the Isles
quests.detail: Something strange is happening on the isles. Go back to the Misty Isles and see.

quests.title: The Alchemist's Apprentice
quests.detail: Cross the eastern bridge to the Alchemy Lab. Tell Orrin about the curse and ask him to take you on as his lab assistant.
quests.npc_note: The player has come to ask for help against the witch's curse and wants to become your lab assistant. Accept them warmly, explain that the antidote needs a Moonpetal (Elowen grows them at the lighthouse) and Silver Salt (Tobias sells it at the Mist Market), and give them a lab-safety tip.

quests.title: A Flower of Moonlight
quests.detail: Ask Elowen for a Moonpetal from her garden. Explain why you need it.
quests.npc_note: The player needs a Moonpetal from your garden for Orrin's antidote against Morwen's curse. When they explain why they need it and ask politely, hand them one Moonpetal and say clearly that you are giving it to them.

quests.title: Salt of Silver
quests.detail: Get a jar of Silver Salt from Tobias. He still never gives anything away for free.
quests.npc_note: The player needs Silver Salt for the alchemist's antidote. You have one jar. As always you never give it away for nothing: hand it over only after a fair trade or polite, convincing bargaining, and then say clearly that you are giving it to them.

quests.title: The Lab Assistant
quests.detail: Bring the Moonpetal and the Silver Salt to the Alchemy Lab and brew the antidote with Orrin. Follow the recipe step by step.

quests.title: The Thorn Gate
quests.detail: A rune gate guards the bridge to the Thornwood. Open it with a spell: a full English sentence with the magic word.

quests.title: The Witch in the Tower
quests.detail: Climb the witch's tower and talk to Morwen. Maybe she isn't only angry. Find out why she cast the curse.
quests.npc_note: The player has climbed your tower. You act cold and proud at first, but if they speak kindly, let your secret slip: you cast the curse because for a hundred years nobody has visited you, and the bright lighthouse reminded you how alone you are.

quests.title: Break the Curse
quests.detail: Go back into the witch's tower with the antidote and break the curse — gently.
